english.note: This is the all-purpose expression for saying that one quantity varies in direct ratio to another.
Use this when the relationship is specifically proportional or follows a measurable ratio.

examples.english: When cooking rice, the amount of water is proportional to the amount of rice.
examples.traditional: 煮飯時，落水嘅分量同米嘅分量成正比。
examples.jyutping: zyu2 faan6 si4 lok6 seoi2 ge3 fan6 loeng6 tung4 mai5 ge3 fan6 loeng6 sing4 zing3 bei2

examples.english: Pay should be commensurate with the amount of work.
examples.traditional: 工資要同工作量成正比。
examples.jyutping: gung1 zi1 jiu3 tung4 gung1 zok3 loeng6 sing4 zing3 bei2
